totalScreens.description: Video panes to fill, up to rows x columns. Defaults to 4.

sceneOrder.description: How each pane orders its scenes. The favour orders shuffle with a bias; Fewer repeats plays recently watched scenes last. Defaults to random.

options.label: Favour high ratings and O counts

spreadScenes.description: Avoid playing scenes with the same performer or studio back to back or side by side. Enabled by default.

splitScenes.description: Give each pane its own share of the scenes instead of every pane drawing from the whole list. Disabled by default.

avoidDuplicates.displayName: Avoid the same scene on several screens
avoidDuplicates.description: Start every screen on a different scene, and skip scenes already playing on another screen when moving to the next one. Going back or choosing a search result can still repeat a scene. Enabled by default.

startMuted.description: Start every video muted. Enabled by default.

randomStart.description: Jump to a random point when a scene starts. Enabled by default.

loopScenes.description: Repeat a scene instead of advancing to the next one. Enabled by default.

pauseWhenHidden.description: Pause every pane while the browser tab is hidden. Enabled by default.

markerDuration.displayName: Marker length without an end time
markerDuration.description: Seconds to play a marker that has no end time. Defaults to 30.

showInMenu.description: Show the DirtyMultiscreen button in Stash's top bar. When hidden, the player stays reachable by URL. Enabled by default.

sections.title: Grid
sections.description: How many panes play at once.

sections.title: Scenes
sections.description: Which scene each pane plays next.
